import sys,re
h=open('pygram/variant/pygram_unsupported.h').read()
seg=h.split('static const char pygram_cpython_stdlib[] =')[1].split(';')[0]
names=[]
for m in re.findall(r'"((?:[^"\\]|\\.)*)"', seg):
    names += [x for x in m.split('\\0') if x]
print('blob names:', len(names))
blob=sum(len(n)+1 for n in names)+1
print('blob bytes (incl NULs + terminator):', blob)
alln=sorted(sys.stdlib_module_names)
print('cpython names:', len(alln))
under=sorted(n for n in sys.stdlib_module_names if n.startswith('_'))
print('underscore:', len(under), 'bytes:', sum(len(n)+1 for n in under))
missing=set(alln)-set(names)
extra=set(names)-set(alln)
print('missing from blob:', len(missing))
print('extra in blob (not in cpy 3.11):', sorted(extra))
print('full blob bytes:', sum(len(n)+1 for n in alln)+1)
print()
print('underscore names:', ' '.join(under))

import sys

lines, cur = [], ''
for p in parts:

        lines.append(cur); cur = ''
    cur += p
